{{Top|leg}}
'''Denym''' was a rugged textile used in the construction of heavy-labor clothing employed by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and the like. It held up under harsh conditions and did not require frequent replacement, although the material did tend to fade after prolonged usage.

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The spelling and usage of ''denym'' is most likely a derivative of the the more common word, ''denim''.
